data.name: A show she never watched.
data.detailed_description:
"When reality crashes against the boundaries of delusion, and your eyes open only in the face of dreams — how is it possible to escape this wall built from warped memories?"

In A show she never watched., you play as Clara, a girl unlike any other. Trapped in her own little bubble, she has no friends, no social life, and never leaves her home.

One night, while watching a documentary on her brand-new TV, the broadcast suddenly cuts out, replaced by a mysterious TV host who seems to be speaking directly to her.

Clara doesn’t know it yet, but this strange encounter will drag her down an endless rabbit hole deep down her dreams, forcing her to question everything she believes about herself and the world around her.

Will you truly understand Clara?

Will you change her fate… or keep it sealed forever?

Explore dreamlike worlds

Step into Clara’s dreams and pay attention to every detail, some of them may reveal hidden truths.

Interact with the strange inhabitants of these surreal places and uncover the secrets they hold.

Multiple endings, multiple meanings

Make the choices you feel are right… or twist the story on purpose.

"Which delusion will you embrace? The perfect world? The absolute truth? Total destruction? A hollow reality? Or…"

An experimental and unique game

Inspired by a now-abandoned mini web series, and influenced by titles such as ENA: Dream BBQ, LSD: Dream Emulator, Yume Nikki, and the Science Adventure Series. with "A show she never watched." we want delivers a carefully crafted story written straight from the heart.

Our goal is to offer players a bizarre, unforgettable experience unlike anything they’ve seen before.

Memory & Psychological Series Project N°1

"A show she never watched." is the first game of the Memory & Psychological Series (M&P Series). A Sci-Fi video game series developed and written by Source Macchiato.

data.short_description: Clara, a teenager struggling with psychological issues, is visited one night by a mysterious entity through her TV. As she falls asleep, She begins her perilous adventure in her dreams. Will she be able to discover the truth? Or will she continue to dream for eternity?
